palette: kraft paper bench ground + cream graph panels + brass tuning-fork marks + teal resonance rings + carmine clash seam + graphite ink
typography: graphite headings on cream graph plaques, dark bench label tabs with brass left bar, teal chips for chosen paths, carmine stamps for clash verdicts and negations, thin ink underline for tests
composition: the definition strikes one act fork that lands in two liability zones with a carmine clash seam; the mechanism draws two overlapping regulation zones on the bench with a choice fork beside; the closing row sets three cause plaques against a sanction-scale panel and a common-case chip rail
surface: flat kraft ground with faint graph hairlines, cream panels with hairline weathered borders and corner screws, no gradients on panels, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: the fork strikes once and rings, resonance rings expand from the clash seam, regulation zones slide into overlap, the choice fork arms swing to their posts, cause plaques stamp in one by one
transition: the clash seam flashes once and the bench clears for the next experiment
